name: unhappy path: facilitator rejects payment with network_mismatch

steps.name: start resource server (exact only, BSC testnet)
steps.command: @start_bg resource-server env E2E_NETWORK=eip155:97 E2E_SCHEMES=exact E2E_SERVER_PORT=4021 E2E_ASSET_PRICE='0.0001 DHLU' python3 -m e2e.servers.resource_server

steps.name: client: pay (should be rejected, network mismatch)
steps.command: env E2E_NETWORK=eip155:97 E2E_SCHEMES=exact E2E_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4021 E2E_ENDPOINT=/protected E2E_OUTPUT=/tmp/x402-e2e-unhappy-verify-network-mismatch-response.json python3 -m e2e.clients.test_client
